info.name: Get an array of loaded packages

params.name: loadDateEnd
params.description: Specifies the end date of the range for filtering loaded packages. Date format is <YYYY-MM-DD>. (UTC)

params.name: loadDateStart
params.description: Specifies the start date of the range for filtering loaded packages. Date format is <YYYY-MM-DD>. (UTC)

params.name: size
params.description: The size of the page to be returned

params.name: sort
params.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

params.name: status
params.description: Specify the status of packages for filtering: active, inactive, pending.

params.name: tags
params.description: Filter packages based on the distinct combination of tags assigned to the hosts that loaded them.

items.docs:
Get an array of loaded packages.

**Required API permission level:** `SECURITY`
